summary:
Implementation plan for writing two dedicated Python test programs:
1. `test_data_extraction_suite.py`: Comprehensive test suite for all 144 units comparing live Fandom API extraction against curated baseline fallbacks, validating stats (HP, attack, armor, ROF, attack bonuses, armor classes, tech boosts).
2. `test_combat_calculation_suite.py`: Exhaustive calculation testing suite verifying all combat edge cases in `aoe_sl.py` (Knight vs Pikeman, suicide unit exclusions, Obuch shredding, Leitis armor ignore, Charge attack, Multishot, Dry Dock, non-attacking units, simultaneous draws).
3. Verification of `aoe_sl.py` ensuring readiness for Git push and clean Streamlit app deployment.
